relations.rationale: A large crowd gathered for the race implies riders would gather near starting banners.
The crowd size and weather have no bearing on Rosa's relative height to Kai.
A lively crowd at the race supports the idea that cheers rose as cyclists sped off.
A lively crowd being present supports the crowd erupting in applause at the finish.
Ben being lead volunteer is plausibly consistent with him watching riders with a stopwatch, though not directly implied.
Riders gathering near starting banners is consistent with organizers checking registration but doesn't establish it.
Riders gathering at the start has no bearing on Leo's early arrival for setup.
Riders gathering at the start doesn't inform whether leaders passed halfway by midday.
Checking registration lists doesn't indicate anything about Ivo and Rosa's team affiliations.
Registration checks are unrelated to Rosa's pace during the race.
Kai booking the hall doesn't relate to Ben and Kai chatting near the finish line when Rosa arrived.
Booking the hall is an organizational task unrelated to Kai's ranking in prior standings.

Kai booking the hall has no connection to the race starting after the rules were read.
Kai's booking task is unrelated to Ben's age relative to Ivo.

Ben arriving before Kai doesn't establish anything about Leo's dawn arrival.
